data.name: Under Us
data.detailed_description:
After several meteors strike the Earth over 48 hours, a strange and terrifying phenomenon emerges from the depths. Unknown creatures invade the surface, and the world as we knew it is no more. You are one of the last survivors in this devastated world, where each night becomes a true nightmare.

Under Us is a survival horror game where tension is ever-present. The days are your only opportunity to prepare, explore, and plan. But as soon as the sun sets, everything changes... the darkness takes over, and nightmarish creatures roam, ready to devour you. Every night is a battle for survival.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Storyline: Dive into a mysterious narrative, with unsettling revelations as the game progresses. Uncover terrifying secrets about the meteors' origins and the creatures that have overrun the planet.

  • Sandbox Mode: Explore and survive at your own pace in a free-roam mode, either solo or with friends. Discover hidden locations, build shelters, and endure the dangers of the night in an open-world environment.

  • Unpredictable and Terrifying Nights: When night falls, anything can happen. Creatures become more aggressive, strange phenomena occur, and the atmosphere becomes increasingly tense. Be prepared for the unexpected.

  • Realistic Survival System: Eat, drink, and hunt to stay alive. Find sources of water, hunt animals for food, and craft survival tools to endure in a hostile environment.

  • Building and Tool Crafting: Build sturdy shelters to withstand harsh weather and lurking creatures. Craft weapons, traps, and intricate structures to protect yourself from the threats that surround you.

  • Complex Ecosystem: The wildlife in Under Us interacts with the environment and other creatures in realistic ways. Predators, prey, scavengers, and passive-aggressive creatures—all these factors influence the game's dynamics, creating a living, breathing world.

  • Experience and Attribute System: Gain experience to enhance your skills and customize your survival style. Allocate points to different attributes to help you face the growing threats.

  • Mini-Games and Rare Loot: Unlock mini-games as you progress. These challenges will reward you with rare weapons and protection gear.

  • No Microtransactions: No in-game purchases! Everything you need is available as soon as you enter the world of Under Us.

data.short_description: After several small meteors struck the surface of the Earth for more than 48 hours, a strange phenomenon occurred. An unknown and terrifying form of life emerged from the depths. The world is no longer the same. This is a survival horror game where every night becomes a true nightmare.

English*, French*, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 Go) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 Go)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 Go) / AMD Radeon RX 6800 (16 Go)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX 12
